summary: This is a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of common stock by Flexible Solutions International, Inc. The company may sell up to $18.5 million in shares through Bancroft Capital LLC under a sales agreement, with a 3.0% commission. No specific terms or pricing are fixed; sales are made from time to time at market prices. This is a routine capital-raising filing, not a special situation. There are no deal terms such as price per share, premium, or close date. This is equivalent to a standard shelf takedown under Rule 415. No special-situation event is present; it is an ordinary equity issuance.
